text:
Maria: Quick ask — we need a focused perf readout for inference benchmarking next week. Goal: agree on batching + cache changes and a rollout/gating plan. Who can present results and which slot works?
Kevin: I can present the batching experiments (latency vs throughput tradeoffs).
Anika: I can cover the cache policy sims and KV hit-rate numbers.
Suresh: Want the agenda to include quantization sanity checks + perf regression guardrails.
Olivia: I have the 8-bit quant results, can do a 10–15m slot.
Maria: Nice — proposed agenda (high-level): 1) quick baseline numbers (5m), 2) batching experiments (10m), 3) cache policy sims (10m), 4) quantization readout (10m), 5) rollout gating & follow-ups (10m). Total ~45m. Thoughts? :+1: or :thumbsdown: for timing.
Kevin: Sounds good. Add an item to show the p95/p99 tail with and without continuous batching.
Anika: Also show KV cache hit rate by route/model (esp. chat flows). That changed conclusions for a few routes.
bench-bot: Perf digest generated: https://bench.redwood/internal/digests/1918765432 — includes latency/cost table + histogram links.
Maria: Thanks @bench-bot. For scheduling: propose three slots, please react with the slot you prefer or reply:
- Mon 10:00–10:45 PT
- Tue 14:00–14:45 PT
- Wed 16:00–16:45 PT
Kevin: I prefer Tue 14.
Olivia: Mon 10 works for me.
Suresh: Wed 16 is best for me (oncall overlap).
Anika: Tue 14 or Wed 16, leaning Tue.
Maria: OK looks like Tue 14 wins so far. I'll send an invite and add owners: Kevin (batching), Anika (cache), Olivia (quant).
Kevin: Can we add an action item to include the config snippets used for batching so folks can repro? e.g., sample from infra config:
```
batching:
  max_batch_size: 32
  max_latency_ms: 8
  sla_target: p95<150ms
```
Anika: Will attach the sim parameters and a short README. Also will surface the KV cache warmup fail cases we saw.
Maria: Also add a short slide with rollback steps and a canary test plan: traffic %s, SLA monitors, automatic fallback model.
Suresh: Suggest we include cost delta per 1M tokens as a single slide — Execs care about that.
Olivia: I'll add the quantization quality regression numbers (BLEU/ROUGE-ish for our evals) to the deck.
bench-bot: Calendar invite created (provisional): https://calendar.redwood/evt/1918765432 — accepts pending.
Maria: Great. If anyone has blocker items to be discussed (e.g., infra constraints, dataset prep) drop them here before EOD so I can add to the deck.
Kevin: Small note — need GPUs for the live demo; booking infra now.
Anika: I'll paste the sim outputs to the thread tomorrow morning.
Suresh: I'll add the SLA monitoring queries to the doc.
Maria: Thanks all — I'll finalize the agenda and send the invite with the deck link. :rocket:
